generic_lessons: Cold acceptance must use the original failing save, not the successfully repaired preview save, and confirm actual state separately from Load ACK.
A background mode query returning unavailable remains unknown. A separately logged official header navigation is not mode proof; require a fresh independent read before spawn.

Post-load state may differ outside the target effect: ten city coordinates/populations/stocks/productionheads matched but another city food changed13to14 without isolated cause. Do not claim wholeworld equality or zero background actions.

Two ordinary advances across the original starvation countdown with unchanged population establish a narrow stability window, not general starvation prevention or uncertain-submission save/reload safety.

Endpoint qualification must complete before dependent queries. Loading can expose an unqualified secondary listener and later a new primary context; do not replay the official Load to fix diagnostics.
